Messages.Author: Robert Woodruff
Messages.Body:
If a cap 6 vampire with necromancy plays the embrace for 2 blood, then
plays 1 additional for transfusion once the action is successful, and
then targets the embraced vampire. Would the embraced vampire still
need to hunt?
I was curious about the text on The Embrace being just reminder text
as all empty vampires need to hunt or actually forcing the vampire
even if it has blood.

Rob
